tools.name: search_promotions
tools.description: Find current promotions in Singapore (1-for-1s, discounts, freebies, cashback). Use when someone asks 'any deals on X?', 'what's on promotion this weekend?', or about a brand. Returns deals that have not ended, with dates in Singapore time, conditions and the original source link. If you already kno

tools.name: nearby_promotions
tools.description: Find current promotions closest to a location in Singapore, nearest first, with distance in km. Use when someone asks 'deals near me', 'promotions around Tampines' (pass area: 'Tampines', or coordinates). Pass life_stage / age_range / budget / interests when you know them, e.g. a student near NUS: a

tools.name: recommend_promotions
tools.description: Personal picks of current Singapore deals. Use for 'what deals would suit me?', 'any good deals for a student near NUS?', 'deals for my family this weekend', 'I'm visiting Singapore 3-7 Dec, staying near Bugis'. Pass what you already know from the conversation: who they are (life_stage, age_range),

tools.name: get_promotion
tools.description: Full details of one promotion by its id (from a search result): dates, conditions, outlets, source link, and links to add it to a calendar or save it with a start reminder. Pass lat/lng to sort outlets nearest first and get nearest_outlet.

tools.name: get_deal_list
tools.description: A curated list of current Singapore deals: ending-soon (last chance), starting-soon, 1-for-1, free (freebies), birthday (birthday treats), students. Use for questions like 'what deals end this week?' or 'any freebies today?'.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List brands that have at least one current promotion in Singapore, with how many each has.
